content:
A 24-year-old Laredo man has been sentenced to 10 years in prison, probated for 10 years, after pleading guilty to two counts of aggravated assault causing serious bodily injury, according to the Laredo Morning Times. Javier Arreola entered the guilty pleas on September 2 in the 49th District Court, where Judge Jose A. Lopez accepted them, the report says.

The sentences run concurrently, the Times reports. Arreola was also ordered to complete 300 hours of community service and the Thinking Positive for a Change program. The case was filed November 12, 2025; the report notes a date discrepancy in the records, with jail records listing the offense date as May 2024 even as the case is described as a 2025 felony assault matter.

Arreola was arrested in December 2025 in south Laredo, in the 2400 block of Lomas del Sur Boulevard, without incident on a felony aggravated assault warrant, and was booked into the Webb County Jail on a $20,000 bond, according to the Times.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, "Day in court: Laredo man sentenced to 10 years probation for 2025 felony assault," October 31, 2026

title: Laredo man gets 10-year probated sentence in aggravated assault case
